speakers.headline: OpenSearch Ambassador
speakers.biographyMd:
Horovits lives at the intersection of technology, product and open source. With over 20 years in the tech industry as a software developer, a solutions architect and a product manager, he brings a wealth of knowledge in cloud-native architectures, big data solutions, DevOps practices and more.

Horovits is an international speaker, an Ambassador of the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, and host of the popular OpenObservability Talks podcast. On the OpenSearch front, Horovits is an OpenSearch Ambassador under the Linux Foundation, he serves as a lead for the Observability technical advisory group, and is on the project’s outreach committee.

Horovits works as a senior open source advocate at Amazon Web Services, with special focus on the OpenSearch project, open observability, and open source practices.

talks.title: One Stack to Observe Them All: Open Source Observability with OpenSearch
talks.abstractMd:
What if you could have a complete, production-grade observability platform that is fully open source, built on open standards, and led by The Linux Foundation? 

In this session, OpenSearch Ambassador Dotan Horovits demonstrates how OpenSearch delivers a complete, open-source, OpenTelemetry-native observability platform for logs, metrics, traces, APM, and even AI agent observability. You’ll also learn how to integrate with Prometheus metrics, how to create powerful dashboards, and how to easily deploy it to Docker or Kubernetes. 

Whether you’re struggling with finding insights in your mounts of logs, fighting a vendors’ bills and proprietary instrumentation, or looking for advanced agentic observability, this session will give you the open source you don’t want to miss.
